title: A Gravity for the Horizon
author: Mara Lockridge
blurb: Sebastian Nakamura, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
